system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Harmonized Sentinel-2 MSI Level-1C Top-of-Atmosphere Reflectance

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coverage over land areas observed by Sentinel-2, supporting environmental monitoring across diverse terrestrial regions.

data_description.temporal_unit: Per-scene acquisition with irregular revisit intervals
analytical_capabilities: Comparing top-of-atmosphere reflectance across visible, near-infrared, and shortwave-infrared bands
Constructing within-scene and cross-date spectral ratios and normalized differences
Detecting spatially coherent shortwave-infrared anomalies against nearby or earlier reference surfaces
Characterizing the persistence, geometry, and acquisition-to-acquisition variability of spectral anomalies
Auditing cloud, cirrus, viewing-geometry, and surface-reflectance confounding in temporal comparisons

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Top-of-atmosphere reflectance, dimensionless after applying the 0.0001 scale factor
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the harmonized Level-1C collection. B11 and B12 are 20 m shortwave-infrared bands; resample other bands only when needed, mask clouds and cirrus, and match reference scenes by season, viewing geometry, and surface state before comparing weak spectral differences.

data_description.data_source: European Space Agency Copernicus Sentinel-2 mission
